verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers natively supports Cron Triggers and durable Workflows for recurring/multi-step jobs, plus Queues for event-driven orchestration, all documented directly on the Workers product page and Workflows docs, with the Agents SDK adding built-in scheduling for AI agent workloads. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of cron reliability at scale and no community corroboration specifically about scheduled/recurring workflows (only tangential CPU-limit complaints for long-running tasks).
